# Ko-fi
> Creator monetization platform for tips, memberships, commissions, shops, and community support.

Ko-fi helps creators earn directly from supporters with free pages, one-time tips, recurring memberships, digital products, commissions, and creator tools for growing an audience.

## Core Platform
- [Homepage](https://ko-fi.com/): Main entry point for creators to set up pages and start earning.
- [How it works](https://ko-fi.com/features): Overview of Ko-fi monetization features and creator workflows.
- [Pricing](https://ko-fi.com/pricing): Pricing details for free and premium Ko-fi plans.
- [Log in](https://ko-fi.com/account/login): Sign in to an existing Ko-fi creator or supporter account.
- [Sign up free](https://ko-fi.com/account/register): Create a new Ko-fi account and launch a creator page.
- [Blog](https://ko-fi.com/supportkofi?action=posts): Official Ko-fi posts, updates, announcements, and creator-focused articles.

## Monetization Features
- [Memberships](https://ko-fi.com/memberships): Recurring supporter memberships with tiers, perks, and subscriber management.
- [Shop](https://ko-fi.com/shop): Sell digital downloads, physical products, and other creator offerings.
- [Commissions](https://ko-fi.com/commissions): Accept commission requests with structured offerings and order management.
- [Ko-fi for Streamers](https://ko-fi.com/ko-fi-for-streamers): Streamer tools including alerts and audience support integrations.
- [Tips getting started guide](https://help.ko-fi.com/hc/en-us/articles/360014098514-Getting-started-on-Ko-fi): Help article for setting up tips and starting on Ko-fi.

## Help Center
- [Help Center home](https://help.ko-fi.com/hc/en-us): Central support hub for Ko-fi setup, features, and troubleshooting.
- [Getting started on Ko-fi](https://help.ko-fi.com/hc/en-us/articles/360014098514-Getting-started-on-Ko-fi): Introductory guide for creating a page and receiving support.
- [How to Use Ko-fi With Instagram](https://help.ko-fi.com/hc/en-us/articles/360011573238-How-to-Use-Ko-fi-With-Instagram): Guide to promoting and linking Ko-fi from Instagram.
- [How to Use Ko-fi With YouTube](https://help.ko-fi.com/hc/en-us/articles/115003981093-How-to-Use-Ko-fi-With-YouTube): Guide to using Ko-fi alongside a YouTube creator workflow.
- [How to use Ko-fi with TikTok](https://help.ko-fi.com/hc/en-us/articles/8861705943453-How-to-use-Ko-fi-with-TikTok): Instructions for connecting Ko-fi promotion with TikTok content.
- [Submit a request](https://help.ko-fi.com/hc/en-us/requests/new): Contact Ko-fi support for account, billing, or feature issues.

## Creator Use Cases
- [Patreon alternative](https://more.ko-fi.com/patreon-alternative?ref=vs): Comparison page for creators evaluating Ko-fi versus Patreon.
- [Memberships](https://ko-fi.com/memberships): Membership model for creators offering recurring supporter benefits.
- [Shop](https://ko-fi.com/shop): Commerce tools for creators selling products directly to fans.
- [Commissions](https://ko-fi.com/commissions): Service-based monetization for artists and freelance creators.
- [Ko-fi for Streamers](https://ko-fi.com/ko-fi-for-streamers): Streaming-focused support and alert tools for live creators.

## Account Access
- [Login](https://ko-fi.com/account/login): Standard account login page for creators and supporters.
- [Register](https://ko-fi.com/account/register): New account registration page for joining Ko-fi.
- [Login (alternate path)](https://ko-fi.com/Account/Login): Alternate login URL used in site navigation.
- [Homepage](https://ko-fi.com/): Return to the main Ko-fi landing page.

## Community and Updates
- [Ko-fi Blog / Posts](https://ko-fi.com/supportkofi?action=posts): Official updates, feature announcements, and platform news.
- [Support Ko-fi profile](https://ko-fi.com/supportkofi): Ko-fi’s own creator page and platform presence.
- [How it works](https://ko-fi.com/features): Product overview for new creators exploring Ko-fi capabilities.
- [Pricing](https://ko-fi.com/pricing): Current plan information and premium feature access.

## Social Platform Guides
- [Instagram integration guide](https://help.ko-fi.com/hc/en-us/articles/360011573238-How-to-Use-Ko-fi-With-Instagram): Best practices for using Ko-fi with Instagram audiences.
- [YouTube integration guide](https://help.ko-fi.com/hc/en-us/articles/115003981093-How-to-Use-Ko-fi-With-YouTube): Best practices for using Ko-fi with YouTube channels.
- [TikTok integration guide](https://help.ko-fi.com/hc/en-us/articles/8861705943453-How-to-use-Ko-fi-with-TikTok): Best practices for using Ko-fi with TikTok creators.
- [Ko-fi for Streamers](https://ko-fi.com/ko-fi-for-streamers): Streaming-specific tools for live audience engagement and support.
